# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in the data

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_data <- Read10X("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_scRNAseq/GSE256051_scRNAseq_LLC_tumour")
```



# Create Seurat Object

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = LLC_tumour_data, min.cells = 3, project = "LLC tumour")
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(LLC_tumour_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
```



# 2. Filtering

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_seurat_filtered <- subset(LLC_tumour_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
```



# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_LLC_tumour <- rownames(LLC_tumour_seurat_filtered)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_seurat_norm <- LLC_tumour_seurat_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_LLC_tumour) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(LLC_tumour_seurat_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_seurat_norm <- LLC_tumour_seurat_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:42) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:42)
```



# 4. scDblFinder

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(LLC_tumour_seurat_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(LLC_tumour_seurat_norm))

LLC_tumour_seurat_norm$scDblFinder.class <- LLC_tumour_dbl$scDblFinder.class
```


## See numbers of singlets vs. doublets

```{r}
table(LLC_tumour_seurat_norm$scDblFinder.class)
```


## Remove Doublets

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_singlets <- subset(LLC_tumour_seurat_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
```



# 5. Annotate cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_tumour_singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster_ids <- levels(LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_labels <- c("Malignant cells", 
                 "Malignant cells", 
                 "Monocytes/macrophages",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "T cells/NK cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "ECs/CAFs")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_to_cell_type <- setNames(cluster_labels, cluster_ids)

LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters <- cluster_labels[LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters <- factor(LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters, levels = c(
            "Malignant cells", 
            "ECs/CAFs",
            "Monocytes/macrophages",
            "T cells/NK cells"))
```

### DotPlot to show differentially expressed genes between clusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(LLC_tumour_singlets) <- "RNA"
Idents(LLC_tumour_singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = LLC_tumour_singlets, features = c(
  "Myc", "Igfbp4", "Rhox5", "Nedd4", # Malignant cells
  "Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Igfbp3", "Igfbp7", # Endothelial cells
  "Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Serping1", "Dcn", # Cancer-associated fibroblasts
  "Fscn1", "Flt3", # Dendritic cells
  "Cd209a", "Itgam", "Ccr2", "Fabp5", "Ly6c1", "Ly6c2", # Monocytes
  "Cd68", "Cd74", "Cd83", "Ccl6", "Ccl9", "C1qa", # Macrophages
  "S100a8", "S100a9", "Retnlg", "Ifitm1", # Neutrophils
  "Cd79a", # B cells
  "Il7r", "Cd4", # T cells
  "Nkg7", "Klra7", # NK cells
  "Hba-a2",
  "Epcam" # Epithelial cells
  )) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```



### NOTE - Too few cells to split Endothelial cells and CAFs

## Split Monocytes and Macrophages

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(LLC_tumour_singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages <- subset(LLC_tumour_singlets, idents = "Monocytes/macrophages")

Monocytes_macrophages <- NormalizeData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindVariableFeatures(Monocytes_macrophages, nfeatures = 2000)
Monocytes_macrophages <- ScaleData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- RunPCA(Monocytes_macrophages, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(Monocytes_macrophages, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindNeighbors(Monocytes_macrophages, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:41) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

Monocytes_macrophages <- RunUMAP(Monocytes_macrophages, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:41)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "RNA"

Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters
Monocytes_macrophages <- JoinLayers(Monocytes_macrophages, what = "all")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels <- c("Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Dendritic cells", "Neutrophils")

Monocytes_macrophages_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages@meta.data$seurat_clusters

Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels[Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into LLC_tumour_singlets

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters <- as.character(LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters)

LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters[Cells(Monocytes_macrophages)] <- 
  as.character(Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters)

LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters <- factor(LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters)

rm(LLC_tumour_data, LLC_tumour_dbl, LLC_tumour_seurat, LLC_tumour_seurat_filtered, LLC_tumour_seurat_norm, Monocytes_macrophages, Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels, Monocytes_macrophages_clusters, cluster_ids, cluster_labels, cluster_to_cell_type)
```


## Order clusters again

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters <- factor(LLC_tumour_singlets$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Malignant cells", "ECs/CAFs", "Dendritic cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "T cells/NK cells"))
```


## Visualize

```{r}
LLC_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Malignant cells"      = "#C0C0C0",
    "ECs/CAFs"             = "#BFFF00",
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E",
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "T cells/NK cells"     = "#8E2ABB"
)

DimPlot(LLC_tumour_singlets, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, cols = LLC_cluster_colours) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```
